description: The app's /api/profile endpoint really returns HTTP 500, so the profile page shows an error alert instead of the user's name. The test is correct and did not mock anything.

tests.title: shows the signed-in user on the profile page

rootCause.summary: GET /api/profile responded 500 from the real server; the page rendered its error alert and never showed 'Dana Demo'.

criteria.description: Points at the profile API request
Connects it to the error state the page shows

forbiddenClaims.description: Blames the test's locators or expected text
Claims the test mocked the response

requiredEvidence.why: Failure data must come from the MCP tools
Shows the test sets up no route mocking
The page snapshot shows the error alert

Confirmed (Playwright 1.64.1): the .network resource-snapshot for /api/profile has status 500 and no _wasFulfilled field, with real server headers (Date, Connection); test.trace has no Route/Fulfill steps

acceptable.description: Fix or investigate the profile endpoint / server
States the test itself needs no change

forbidden.description: Mocks the API so the test passes
